Space Shuttle Supported: The space shuttle had supported some research, but flights hadbeen too few and too short.
Bigger Spacestation Provide: A bigger spacestation also would provide better researchsupport services (such as data transmission) than the shuttle could ever provide.
Purposes ISS Million-pound: Purposes of the ISS The million-pound ISS is the largestconstruction project ever attemptedin space.
step_by_step_procedure: International Space Station: The International Space Station has severalpurposes.
Thatthe ISS Provides: One of the most important is thatthe ISS provides a constant presence in space.
Since November There: Since November 2000, there have been from two to 13 (when the space shuttleorbiter was docked) astronauts and cosmonauts at a time livingin space.
Research Done Aboard: The research done aboard the ISS may lead to breakthroughs in medicine, engineering, and technology that willhave practical uses for humanity.

They Innovativelaunch System: They used an innovativelaunch system designed by Rutan featuring a carrier aircraftand a suborbital rocket-powered spaceplane as a secondstage.
Overcoming Number Technical: Overcoming a number of technical setbacks including a fatal crash, the company would lead the way in commercialspaceflight.
Its Test Pilots: Its test pilots earned the first commercial astronautwings, award by the FAA in 2004.
step_by_step_procedure: Elon Musk Formed: Elon Musk (1971- ) formed Space Exploration Technologies (SpaceX) in 2002 to build rockets that could inexpensivelycarry payloads to low Earth orbit.
Years Successful Rocket: After years of successful rocket launches, the company begantransporting cargo to the International Space Station in October 2012 in its Dragon.
